test_title: PYST 45: SSC GD Constable 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 06 Mar, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). A is second to the left of D. D is third to the left of E. C is third to the right of G. G is not the immediate neighbour of E. H is third to the right of B. B is second to the right of G. Who is sitting on the immediate left of E?
solution:
Given: Eight girls A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H.

1) A is second to the left of D.

2) D is third to the left of E.

3) C is third to the right of G.

4) G is not the immediate neighbour of E.

5) H is third to the right of B.

6) B is second to the right of G.

Final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b69dc73355a1cc66d040f53dad06a85d6dfeef3886d52441ddf4fac34a381944.png] 

So, **C** is sitting on the immediate left of E.

Hence, the correct answer is **"C".**
